202.    (1)  The  Inland  Revenue  Act,  No.  10  of  2006  is
hereby repealed.
(2) The repealed Act shall continue to apply in respect of
events occurring prior to the date of commencement of this
Act.
(3)  All  appointments  and  delegations  made  under  the
repealed Act and subsisting at the date of commencement of
this  Act  shall  be  deemed  to  be  as  appointments  and
delegations made under this Act.
